protocol: 28 baseline none cases; invisible-payload misses get full-metadata projection with none; visible classification errors get one low follow-up; original baseline scores are preserved.

luna_adjustments.reasoning_effort_transport: OpenAI extra_body passthrough because the installed LiteLLM generic GPT route lacks this parameter

limits: Small manually authored synthetic corpus; labels not independently reviewed.
One baseline call per case; adaptive follow-ups are not held-out evaluation.
No same-corpus Mini test and no global model ranking.
No Registry/Guard/MCP dispatch, wire, or side effect validation.
Latency p95 is nearest-rank over this small sequential run, not a production benchmark.
Cost is an uncached text-rate estimate, not verified billing.
